reason: Partly refuted: the 'do not build' decision is fine, but the finding files these items as refuted/closed on evidence that does not support that. (1) The in-sample exp60 lab gave the wrong sign on this exact axis: cap6 was -0.00057 in the lab and +0.002 on public (probe 45). Noise-level lab gaps cannot 'refute' anything. That covers steal_frac 1.0 (-0.00009, 8 extra insertions, 1 FP event), cap12_fc3 vs cap12_fc2 (-0.00016, 1 FP apart) and 'dominated' scaled caps. The scaled caps are MC-only, built from the 'unc' greedy order in mc.py l.30-38: P(>= 0.957) is 0.37 vs 0.40 for cap 8, inside model noise. (2) The frame-cap-3 closure contradicts itself. cap40_fc3 is +0.00088 vs cap6 in the lab, above cap 8 (+0.00061), which stays alive. Its FP rate per insertion (29/743 = 3.9%) matches cap24_fc2 (22/606 = 3.6%). (3) Item (g), 'cap 8 as a W1 file', is a slot-order choice, not an idea. Filing it as closed under I-363 clashes with the same scan's R20ID-4: in the 46 <= 0.954 row, exp78a goes at 00:50Z. It also clashes with R20ID-5 (iii), where W2 = exp78a, and exp78a's dummy has been clean since 20:02Z. (4) Two items are already closed elsewhere, so they are not new findings: steal-off is I-068, and thr 0.2 (exp73s) went OUT at 13:14Z (I-363 curation 18). One lab fact cuts against the thr-0.2 closure: cap16_fc2_t02 is the highest pooled arm in an2 (+0.00233 vs cap6), even though 44b6 is -0.0015. So its honest closure reason is the MC downside and the plan, not 'refuted'. (5) DIVINS_ALPHA has no lab or public evidence either way. The only sound closure grounds are: no free slot, and for scaled caps, a builder change after the R8 hard line (27 Sep 12:00Z). The steal/no-frame-cap edge damage (unc_fcU adj -0.00055, 519 steals) is the one mechanistic, non-noise point.
fix: Record these in IDEAS as 'closed by priority/schedule', not 'refuted'. Give each row its real reason. Scaled caps: needs a builder change after the R8 hard line (cf. I-220). Steal off: duplicate of I-068 (lab -0.00202, 44b6 -0.0050). thr 0.2: already OUT 13:14Z; note that the lab pooled is actually the highest arm (+0.00233) and the closure rests on the 44b6 -0.0015 / MC downside. steal_frac 1.0 and DIVINS_ALPHA: no slot, no evidence either way. No frame cap: adj edge -0.00055 from 519 steals (mechanistic). fc3: deprioritised because fc2 at the same cap is equal within 1 FP event, not lab-refuted. Drop item (g) from IDEAS entirely: keep exp78a (cap 8, dummy clean 20:02Z) as the fallback/W2 file that R20ID-4 and R20ID-5 (iii) assign it. Add the caveat 'lab sign wrong at cap6 (-0.00057 lab vs +0.002 public)' to every lab-based line.
